title: Evia v1.0
details: Evia v1.0 establishes learner-facing release updates. Future updates will appear on the Home screen when they are downloaded and ready to install.
whatsNew: Smarter 12-week targets paced across the remaining review periods so Course and Learning are completed by the planned EPA or course end date.
Targets now include live measurable progress, direct links to the right part of Evia and Review History for Milos review outcomes.
My EPA brings readiness, assessment information, Learning Hours and review targets together in one learner view.
Learning Support has clearer before-and-after previews, stronger reading adjustments and full-screen translucent tint overlays.
The compact top-right tools menu keeps Chat, Targets, Profile, EPA and Settings off the Home screen.
Teach Me focuses on the actual course subject and Learning Hours use the requirement supplied by Naxos.
